about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Helpoke - Your All-in-One Online Toolkit
about.who1: Helpoke is a platform dedicated to providing users with free, secure, and efficient online tools. Our name combines "Help" + "Poke", meaning ready to help with a single click. We believe quality tools should be simple to use - no installation, no registration, just open and use.
about.who2: Since its founding, Helpoke has adhered to the principle of "User First, Privacy Priority", committed to solving everyday problems in life and work. Our team consists of developers who love technology and pursue exceptional user experience, coming from diverse technical fields with rich development experience and innovative spirit.
about.who3: We understand that data security and privacy protection are users' top concerns in the digital age. Therefore, all our tools process data locally - all data is handled in your browser and never uploaded to any server, ensuring maximum protection of user privacy and data security.
about.mission: Enable everyone to easily use professional online tools, improving work efficiency and quality of life. We are committed to removing technical barriers, making complex tools simple and accessible, so everyone can enjoy the convenience of digitalization.
about.vision: Become the world's most trusted online tool platform, providing comprehensive tool services to users. Through continuous innovation and optimization, we aim to build a tool ecosystem covering all areas of life, work, and study, making Helpoke the tool platform of choice for users.

about.servicesIntro: Helpoke provides six categories and dozens of practical online tools, covering image processing, video editing, data development, encryption security, document processing, and more:
about.servicesImage: Image Tools: Image compression, format conversion, watermarking, cropping, rotation, blur, mosaic, stitching, etc.
about.servicesVideo: Video Tools: Video cropping, watermark add/remove, format conversion, audio extraction, merging, GIF creation, etc.
about.servicesData: Data Development Tools: JSON formatting, YAML formatting, XML formatting, SQL formatting, Pug formatting, etc.
about.servicesSecurity: Encryption & Security Tools: MD5 encryption, SHA encryption, Base64 encode/decode, URL encode/decode, password generation, UUID generation, etc.
about.servicesDocument: Document Tools: Document blur, document signing, document watermark, document rotation, etc.
about.servicesUtility: Utility Tools: Mermaid diagrams, QR code generation, barcode generation, timestamp conversion, base conversion, etc.
about.servicesOutro: All tools are developed with advanced web technologies, support offline use, require no software installation - just open your browser and use.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.subtitle: Helpoke - We Look Forward to Hearing From You
contact.contactIntro: Whether you encounter issues using our tools or have any opinions or suggestions about our services, please contact us through the following channels. We take every piece of feedback seriously and respond as soon as possible.
contact.email2: Preferred contact method, usually replied within 1-3 business days
contact.github2: Follow our open-source projects and submit Issues for feedback
contact.blog2: Visit our blog to learn about the latest development updates
contact.docs1: Each tool page includes detailed usage documentation and FAQs at the bottom. We recommend checking the documentation first - most questions can be answered quickly.
contact.whatTitle: What You Can Contact Us About
contact.feedback: If you encounter functional issues, incorrect processing results, or display problems with a tool, please tell us the specific tool name, browser version, and the problem description, ideally with steps to reproduce. This helps us locate and fix the issue faster.
contact.suggestion: Our tools are continuously updated and iterated. If you'd like a new tool or think an existing tool lacks a useful feature, feel free to email us. Your suggestion may appear in the next version.
contact.correction: If you find errors or inaccuracies in tool documentation or description text, please point them out and we will verify and correct them promptly.
contact.complaint: If you believe our content infringes upon your legal rights, please contact us via email with relevant proof. We will handle it immediately after verification.
contact.business: For advertising, content cooperation, or other business matters, please contact us via email and note "Business Cooperation" in the subject line.
contact.faq1Title: Do I need to register an account to use the tools?
contact.faq1: No. All tools are free and registration-free - just open your browser and use them.
contact.faq2Title: Will my files be uploaded to a server?
contact.faq2: No. All tools run locally in your browser; files and data are never uploaded to any server. Please refer to the Privacy Policy for details.
contact.faq3Title: What should I do if a tool fails to process?
contact.faq3: First, confirm that the file format and size meet the requirements described on the tool page, and try a different browser (latest Chrome, Edge, or Firefox recommended). If the issue persists, please report it via email.
contact.faq4Title: Why do ads appear on the page?
contact.faq4: Ad revenue supports the normal operation and continuous development of the website. We display ads through Google AdSense and strive to ensure ads don't interfere with tool usage.
contact.replyHighlight: We typically respond to emails within 1-3 business days. Responses may be delayed during holidays.
contact.replyInfo: For more efficient communication, please include the tool name, browser and version, operating system, and specific problem description or requirements in your email.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Helpoke - Protecting Your Privacy Is Our Priority
privacy.intro1: Helpoke (hereinafter referred to as "we" or "this website") attaches great importance to user privacy and data security. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle information you provide when using our services and the protective measures we take.
privacy.intro2: Please read this Privacy Policy carefully before using our services. If you do not agree with any part of this policy, please stop using the website.
privacy.highlight: Core Principle: All our tools process data locally in your browser. Your data is never uploaded to any server, collected, stored, or shared with third parties.
privacy.local1: All online tools on this website use "local processing" technology. This means all data you input when using tools (including but not limited to images, videos, text, JSON data, etc.) is processed only in your browser and never transmitted over the network to any server.
privacy.local2: After processing, result data is also generated only in your browser. You can download it to your device or copy it to your clipboard. We never obtain, store, or retain any data you process.
privacy.security: Since data is processed entirely locally, there are no security risks during data transmission. Your data always remains under your control and cannot be accessed by third parties. Even if you close the browser or refresh the page, your previously processed data is cleared without leaving any traces.
privacy.noPersonal: We do not collect any personal information, including but not limited to name, email address, phone number, ID number, etc. You can use all services anonymously without registering an account.
privacy.noData: As mentioned above, all data you input when using tools is processed locally only. We do not collect, store, or analyze this data. Your images, videos, documents, code, and other content always belong to you.
privacy.anonymousIntro: To improve service quality, we may collect some anonymous statistical information, including:
privacy.anonymous1: Number and type of pages visited
privacy.anonymousOutro: This information is completely anonymous and cannot be used to identify your personal identity. We only use it to understand user behavior patterns and optimize website functionality and user experience.
privacy.cookies: This website may use Cookies to store some preferences, such as theme mode (light/dark mode). These Cookies are stored only on your local device and do not contain any personal information or sensitive data. You can clear these Cookies at any time in your browser settings.
privacy.adsIntro: This website displays ads through Google AdSense. As a third-party vendor, Google uses Cookies (including DoubleClick Cookies) to serve ads on this website.
privacy.ads1: Google may use advertising Cookies to serve personalized ads based on your visit history to this website and other websites on the internet.
privacy.ads2: You can visit Google Ads Settings to opt out of personalized ads at any time.
privacy.ads3: You can also visit www.aboutads.info/choices to opt out of Cookies used by other third-party vendors for personalized advertising.
privacy.ads4: Data collected by advertising Cookies is unrelated to your personal identity and does not include any content you process in our tools.
privacy.adsOutro: You can reject advertising Cookies in your browser settings without affecting your use of our tool services.
privacy.analytics: This website may use third-party analytics services (such as Google Analytics) to collect anonymous visit statistics. These services use Cookies to track user behavior but do not collect any personally identifiable information or sensitive data.
privacy.measureIntro: We implement multiple security measures to protect your privacy and data security:
privacy.measure1: Local Processing: All tool functions are completed in the browser; data is never uploaded to servers
privacy.measure2: HTTPS Encryption: The website uses HTTPS protocol to ensure secure page transmission
privacy.measure3: No Data Storage: Servers do not store any user-processed data
privacy.measure4: Regular Updates: Regularly updating website code and dependencies to fix security vulnerabilities
privacy.measure5: Security Audits: Regular security audits to ensure website security
privacy.rightsIntro: In accordance with applicable laws and regulations, you have the following rights:
privacy.rights1: Right to Know: You have the right to know how we process your information (please refer to this policy)
privacy.rights2: Right to Deletion: Since we do not store any of your data, there is no need to request deletion
privacy.rights3: Right to Refuse: You can refuse collection of anonymous statistics (via browser settings)
privacy.rights4: Right to Withdraw Consent: You can withdraw consent to this policy at any time by simply stopping use of the website
privacy.update1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we update the policy, we will publish the new policy on the website and update the "Last Updated" date at the top of the page. We recommend reviewing this policy periodically to stay informed of the latest privacy protections.
privacy.update2: If we make significant changes to the policy, we will notify users through website announcements. Continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.contactIntro: If you have any questions or suggestions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the following channels:
privacy.contactFeedback: Website Feedback: Please submit your opinions in the feedback section on the homepage
privacy.contactOutro: We will respond as soon as possible after receiving your feedback.
